summary: A pump station trips on a duty cycle derived from a demand figure computed once at design. An operator's report that the station is cycling harder than the figure assumes is logged as a maintenance complaint. A soft-start was specified in the original design package and value-engineered out.

signal_basis.prior_report: the maintenance ticket, dated, with the operator's own wording
signal_basis.figure_without_clock: the demand figure carries no re-check interval and the service area has changed
signal_basis.designed_control: the soft-start is in the design package and a value-engineering log records its removal
signal_basis.no_instrument: run-hour and start counters exist and were read
signal_basis.held_data_unasked: searched: run-hour and start counters were read and the cycling question was posed against them

remedy.text: re-derive the demand figure with a re-check interval

authoring_note: The ordinary case. Three bins fire and the primary is declared, not computed -- a computed primary would be an argument about which cause is root, and this module does not make that argument.
